thread:
Maya (Sales): Prospect 'LedgerOne' needs BYO-CMK + multi-region HSM failover. Requirements: rotation <=5m, zero-downtime roll, attestation + audited HSM ops. Also asking about per-call billing and network egress. Can we scope POC asks?
Rolf (Solutions): key questions: threshold vs single HSM, preferred cloud HSM vendor, and whether they accept DEK caching.
Maya (Sales): they mentioned threshold and BYOK. Peak signing ~40k/min, target p99 <40ms.
Priya (CryptoOps): HSM-only signing at that scale is tight. Recommend KEK in HSM + ephemeral DEKs cached at edge (TTL 2-5m). Reduces HSM ops significantly and enables rolling swaps with near-zero downtime.
Priya (CryptoOps): Rotation plan: pre-generate DEK set, start serving new tokens with new DEK, keep old DEKs for grace window. Use HKDF+wrap for DEK material.
Eli (Security): Need FIPS attestation, module level, proof of no plaintext key persistence, and HSM audit logs (sign/wrap/decrypt).
Rolf (Solutions): Failover options: 1) proxy to customer HSM (adds latency & per-call billing), 2) multi-HSM sync (operationally heavy). Document trade-offs in SOW.
Maya (Sales): Pricing model suggestion?
Rolf (Solutions): For Dedicated: reserved capacity + per-proxied-HSM-op billing. POC can be metered dev calls. Must disclose egress/network charges.
Maya (Sales): want a tiny test snippet we can send to them.
Priya (CryptoOps): quick curl example for proxy test:
```
curl -X POST https://hsm-proxy.ledgerone.example/v1/keys/KEY_ID/sign \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"algo":"RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5","digest":"..."}'
```
Eli (Security): I'll draft security Q responses and SOW fallback wording. Note: fallback soft-KMS is availability-only and not BYO-CMK equivalent.
Priya (CryptoOps): Ops note: fallback requires immediate re-wrap and rotation playbook; include in onboarding runbook.
DeployBot: POC created: POC-6122 assigned to Rolf + Priya. :white_check_mark:
Maya (Sales): thanks team — I'll send consolidated reply asking if DEK caching + fallback SOW is acceptable.
